Blue Sea signature maker (Final Form 2.0, mobile first)

Type one person's details, check the preview, then download their signature file. One 320px column: it looks the same on phones, in Outlook classic and everywhere else.

Phone, address and links are the same for everyone and already in the signature.

  1. Leave every field empty to download the editable template (placeholders), for people who will type their own details in Outlook.
  2. The file is named after the person. That name is what they will see in Outlook's signature list.
  3. Nothing typed here is saved or sent anywhere.
  4. iPhone Mail: tap Show signature only, select it all, copy, paste into Settings → Apps → Mail → Signature, then shake (or swipe left with three fingers) and tap Undo to keep the styling.
  5. Nothing in this signature sits side by side or changes with screen width, so every view shows the same layout.
